title: Unbonded Archive Catalogue of Sources on Bonded Labour in Nepal
description: A curated catalogue of research papers, reports, legal texts and datasets on the Kamaiya, Haliya, Haruwa-Charuwa and Kamlari bonded-labour systems in Nepal, with each source's method, study population, sample, geography, recorded findings, citation and link. The website is at https://unbondedarchive.org/; the catalogue files are built into data/ on the site. Corrections and additions are logged in data/CORRECTIONS.md.
